name: iCloud Plus
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For ICloud Plus, sync a selected folder and photo export through user-owned storage. The hard boundary is deep apple os integration, device backup, photos, family sharing, and account recovery, plus reliability, durability, and cross-device sync.
